summary: Yalla Group Limited filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited second-quarter 2026 financial results. The press release reports revenues of $82.6 million (down from $84.6 million a year earlier), net income of $29.3 million, and non-GAAP net income of $34.4 million. Average MAUs rose 12.3% to 47.6 million, while paying users declined to 10.9 million. Management commentary highlights growth in gaming revenues and new game development. This is a routine earnings release with no special-situation elements such as mergers, tender offers, or strategic changes. No deal terms or unusual corporate actions are disclosed.
